findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.comment: Observed were two dead insects underneath the triple sink and under a rack that stores pizza boxes. The facility has active pest control, however, discussed the need to routinely clean back storage areas to help prevent harboring conditions for insects. There was minimal food residue and other debris on the floors of the back storage area. Ensure that insects are removed and the premise is maintained free of insects.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.111 (A)(B) and (D) Controlling Pests. The PREMISES shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests shall be controlled to eliminate their presence on the PREMISES by: (A) Routinely inspecting incoming shipments of FOOD and supplies; (B) Routinely inspecting the PREMISES for evidence of pests; and (D) Eliminating harborage conditions.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The current caulk that is at the back of the handwashing sink is starting to pull from the wall. There was a significant amount of debris accumulation observed where the broken caulk is placed. Ensure to remove current caulk and seal gap to prevent debris accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: There are several broken floor tiles throughout the back storage area. The missing tiles in front of the triple sink have been replaced, however, there are broken and missing tiles under the prep table and along the back wall where the back door is located. Ensure that physical facilities are maintained in good repair and that the floor tiles are replaced.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The corner wall seal leading to the entrance of the office area is pulling away from the wall. Shown to the PIC. See that seal is replaced or repaired.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Staff was observed donning new gloves without handwashing. Education was conducted regarding when to wash. Ensure staff are washing hands before donning a new pair of gloves.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.14 When to Wash. FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms as specified under § 2-301.12 immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including working with exposed FOOD, clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, and unwrapped SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES and: (A) After touching bare human body parts other than clean hands and clean, exposed portions of arms; (B) After using the toilet room; (C) After caring for or handling SERVICE ANIMALS or aquatic animals as specified in 2-403.11(B); (D) Except as specified in 2-401.11(B), after coughing, sneezing, using a handkerchief or disposable tissue, using TOBACCO PRODUCTS, eating, or drinking; (E) After handling soiled EQUIPMENT or UTENSILS; (F) During FOOD preparation, as often as necessary to remove soil and contamination and to prevent cross contamination when changing tasks; (G) When switching between working with raw FOOD and working with READY-TO-EAT FOOD; (H) Before donning gloves to initiate a task that involves working with FOOD; and (I) After engaging in other activities that contaminate the hands.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Handwashing was unavailable at the time of inspector's arrival. The installed hand sink was not functional. A free-flowing portable hand sink was delivered during the inspection.
findings.citation_text: 5-203.11(A) Handwashing Sinks. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, at least 1 HANDWASHING SINK, a number of HANDWASHING SINKS necessary for their convenient use by EMPLOYEES in areas specified under § 5-204.11, and not fewer than the number of HANDWASHING SINKS required by LAW shall be provided.

findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.comment: There was a hand brush stored directly above pizzas that were prepped to go into the cooking oven. Discussed and shown to PIC. The brush was moved to a different location. The hand brush is used to brush food residuals from the prep tables. Ensure that hand brushes are stored in a manner that protects against food contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-302.11(A)(1) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (1) Except as specified in (1)(d) below or when combined as ingredients, separating raw animal FOODS during storage, preparation, holding, and display from: (a) Raw READY-TO-EAT FOOD including other raw animal FOOD such as FISH for sushi or MOLLUSCAN SHELLFISH, or other raw READY-TOEAT FOOD such as fruits and vegetables, (b) Cooked READY-TO-EAT FOOD, and (c) Fruits and vegetables before they are washed; (d) Frozen, commercially processed and packaged raw animal FOOD may be stored or displayed with or above frozen, commercially processed and packaged, ready-to-eat food.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: There is a missing floor tile in front of the triple sink. Repair floor tile. Ensure that physical facilities are maintained in good repair.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
Observed a couple employees turning off faucet handles without a barrier after the handwashing process. Discussed with PIC to educate staff on proper handwashing techniques. Ensure that employees are using barriers to turn off faucet handles after washing hands in order to prevent recontaminating freshly washed hands. 

Also, if tasks change, be sure to wash hands before donning gloves when engaging in food preparation.

2-301.12: (A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. (D) Automatic handwashing facility may be used if APPROVED.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: There is observed a broken floor tile under the pizza oven and a broken floor tile near the triple sink. There is also observed coving in a state of disrepair near the office and near the back entrance door. Ensure repairs are made to these locations to ensure all surfaces are smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: There is observed an accumulation of food debris under the soda storage racks in the corners of the display. Ensure these areas are routinely cleaned to prevent the accumulation of food debris. 
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed mops to not be stored in a position that allows them to air dry. A mop was stored in the mop bucket and in the mop sink. Ensure mops are stored in a position that allows them to air dry. 

6-501.16: After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.comment:
7-102.11: Observed a bottle of sanitizer to not be labeled at the time of inspection. The bottle was labeled during the inspection. Ensure all bottles of chemicals and sanitizers are clearly labeled at all times. 
Working containers used for storing POISONOUS OR TOXIC MATERIALS such as cleaners and SANITIZERS taken from bulk supplies shall be clearly and individually identified with the common name of the material.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.citation_text: 750.540 (C) The food establishment is not under the operational supervision of a Certified Food Service Sanitation Manager that is present at appropriate times. Provide an adequate number of staff with approved training. Reference 750.540.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.citation_text: 7-102.11  (Pf) Observed a spray bottle containing sanitizer to not be properly labeled. Containers of toxic materials must be clearly and individually identified with the common name of the material. The sanitizer was labeled during the inspection.

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored
findings.citation_text: 3-304.14  (C) Observed a sani bucket in use that measured 0 ppm of quat. Sani buckets with wiping cloths should maintain a concentration of 200-400 ppm of quat when being used and be changed every 4 hours.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.citation_text: 4-302.14  (Pf) Test strips were not available for use during the inspection. PIC stated that test strips were ordered.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13  (C) Observed dust and soil residue build up on the fan in the walk in cooler. Ensure that the fan in the walk in cooler is cleaned as needed to avoid contamination and to maintain clean.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment: 6-501.16  (C) Observed a mop to be laying on the floor. Mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies.  Reference 6-501.16.
findings.citation_text: 6-201.11  (C) Observed a broken floor tile near the mop sink. All non-food contact surfaces must be maintained in order to be smooth and easily cleanable.

findings.title: Presence of insects/rodents.  Animals prohibited
findings.comment: Observed more than ten (10) drain/sewer flies in and around the mop sink area.

findings.title: Proper hygienic practices, eating/drinking/smoking (evidence)
findings.comment:
Personal drinks and cell phones in food prep areas

750-530e Employees shall maintain a high degree of personal cleanliness and shall conform to good hygienic practices during all working periods in the food service establishment.

findings.title: Containers covered, adequate number, insect and rodent proof, emptied at proper intervals, clean
findings.comment:
No top on trash can in womens restroom

750-1130a Garbage and refuse shall be kept in durable easily cleanable, insect-proof, and rodent-proof containers.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
Floors in kitchen area soiled

750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
Walls in kitchen covered in dust

750-1220 Walls, ceilings, and attached fixtures shall be kept clean. Clean the walls and ceilings.

findings.title: Foods handled with minimal manual contact
findings.comment:
Observed an employee touch a pizza with bare hands as it was being put into a box. Once pizzas are cooked, avoid bare hand contact.
750-280 Food handlers & consumers shall avoid direct hand contact with ready to eat foods.  When handling ready to eat foods use suitable utensils (gloves, tongs, scoop, deli tissue, etc.)

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.comment:
Observed a pair of tongs with the handles stored in contact with the wings in the bottom of the prep cooler. Tongs were removed during the inspection to correct the violation. 
750-280 Food dispensing utensils shall be stored in the food with the handle extending out of the food; or stored clean and dry; or stored in running potable water dipper wells.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed the undersides of the lids to the pizza prep cooler to be soiled where the lids are opened and closed. Wash, rinse and sanitize the lids at least every 4 hours at these touch points.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
Observed the sinks in the women's restroom to be slow draining. Repair plumbing so that sinks may drain effectively.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
Restrooms do not have covered waste cans. Provide covered waste cans in the restrooms.
750-1110d Toilet facilities shall be kept clean and in good repair and free of objectionable odors. A supply of toilet tissue shall be provided at each toilet at all times. Easily cleanable, covered receptacles shall be provided for waste materials.

findings.title: Toxic items properly stored
findings.comment:
CORRECTED> Observed chemical spray bottles to be stored in the racks with soda and one to be hanging on the side of the clean dish rack. Chemical spray bottles were moved to the chemical storage rack during the inspection. 
750-1310 All toxic items must be properly stored (i.e. segregated from food) to reduce the potential for cross contamination.  Properly store all chemicals.

findings.title: Toxic items labeled and used properly
findings.comment:
CORRECTED> Observed a chemical spray bottle that was not labeled with the name of the contents. Spray bottle was emptied during the inspection to correct the violation. 
750-1300 Containers of poisonous or toxic materials necessary for the maintenance of the establishment shall be labeled in accordance with law. Properly label containers of toxic substances.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
CORRECTED> Observed sauce on the make line that was not date or time marked and was reported to have been from last night. This sauce was discarded during inspection and a new batch was placed on the make line and time marked to expire after the allowed 10 hours to be at 10 pm. Make sure that sauce is being marked with the time it was prepared and held at room temperature no longer than the amount of time allowed. Papa Johns corporate food safety allows for sauce to be at room temperature for 10 hours. 
750-153(a) Food shall not be held more that 4 hours past the point it is removed from temperature control. Do not hold food in excess of four hours after removal from temperature control.

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.comment:
CORRECTED> Observed the tong handles to be stored in direct contact with the peppers that are placed in the pizza box. Tongs were moved during inspection and staff was educated by manager on this. Store tongs with the handles extended up and out of the food.
750-280 Food dispensing utensils shall be stored in the food with the handle extending out of the food; or stored clean and dry; or stored in running potable water dipper wells.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment: Maintenance is on site working on painting the ceiling tile grids.
